description: The VCL counterpart of 19_frame_grows_and_says_so. A caption too long for its frame makes the frame grow, and the growth has to be written down as well as planned. A frame carries no text of its own, so the pass that states a new size for translated controls never speaks for it: the plan grew the panel and the pack said nothing, and the check box was clipped by a container with room to spare everywhere except where it counted.
